prerequisites: None. Competences taught in the advanced modules (topic-dependent) are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: have in-depth knowledge and skills in a selected specialized area of computer science
can report on current research results and deal with research literature

can apply computer science methods to the selected specialized area of computer science (developing and applying fundamental solution strategies and their formal description, training abstract thinking, system development)
are able to apply scientific working methods to solve problems independently and communicate the solution
have acquired competencies preferably in the field of Artificial Intelligence

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise assignments
Written exam or oral exam (individual exam)

assessment_rules: Grading is based on a scale of 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science degree program. To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution to at least two of the exercise assignments. The final examination is either a written or an oral exam.
